beats.text: Dawn light touched the clearing where Lirael stood, the weight of first rites settling across her shoulders.
She knew every step of the ceremony yet felt the gap between knowledge and performance like a held breath.
Seren knelt before her, the young Graduant's posture perfect from rehearsal.

beats.speaker: Seren
beats.text: I wish that Lirael may find the one she lost.
The assembly turned as one, eyes searching Lirael for the loss Seren had named.

beats.speaker: the_presiding_Dohkar
beats.text: You have shaped the wish for your own benefit and interfered in the rite.
Julian stepped from the edge, voice calm amid the sudden stillness.

beats.speaker: Julian
beats.text: I can hear she is aligned with her own innocence.
Seren remained kneeling as the rite held its fragile center.
Lirael felt the assembly's gaze press against her like a second skin.
She tore the band and the wish bent, no visible light, only turning heads.
Her pulse hammered; failure here would follow her name for years.

beats.speaker: the_presiding_Dohkar
beats.text: Lirael stands accused of interference. Her path to Dohkar, Chayr, Provast is in question.
The charge landed like iron; her father's office suddenly farther than the clearing's edge.
Julian placed The Answer into her palms, closing her fingers around the cool weight.

beats.speaker: Julian
beats.text: Any misalignment will be plain to everyone present.
Lirael met his eyes and felt the public claim of her desire settle between them.
The path she had trained for now hinged on the next words she chose.

interrogationExchange.speaker: Julian
interrogationExchange.text: You manipulated her without knowing it, the way you manipulate everyone through desirability.

interrogationExchange.speaker: Julian
interrogationExchange.text: Your hand lingered on the band; your attention kept finding me at the edge.

interrogationExchange.speaker: Julian
interrogationExchange.text: Did you call to me hoping I would rescue you?
Lirael felt heat rise under the assembly's stare.

interrogationExchange.speaker: Lirael
interrogationExchange.text: Yes. I wanted you to step forward.

interrogationExchange.speaker: Julian
interrogationExchange.text: Then own it plainly. The attraction is not hidden from me.

interrogationExchange.speaker: Lirael
interrogationExchange.text: It is true. I called to you.

temptation.action: Lean closer and hold his gaze

silence.action: Lower eyes and wait without speaking

reversal.action: Turn the question back on his intent
reversal.dialogue: Why frame rescue as my manipulation?

boundary.action: State the limit on public questioning

confession.action: Admit the precise moment of wanting rescue
confession.dialogue: When the wish bent, I hoped you would answer.
